title: Aptamer-functionalized EGCG nanocarrier for neutrophil-targeted AKBA delivery promotes anxiety-related fracture healing

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Aptamer-functionalized EGCG nanocarrier for neutrophil-targeted AKBA delivery promotes anxiety-related fracture healing》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Introduction · p0030】Delayed or non-union bone fracture remains one of the most challenging complications in orthopaedics, and its pathogenesis extends far beyond local tissue damage [[1], [2], [3]]. Epidemiological and clinical evidence consistently indicate that patients with comorbid anxiety or depression exhibit greater bone loss, higher fracture incidence, and protracted healing [[4], [5], [6]]. For these patients, already burdened by psychological distress, impaired fracture repair further increases the risk of permanent disability [[7], [8], [9], [10]], worsens long-term functional outcomes, and escalates healthcare costs—a dual physiological and psychological toll that makes this population a pressing target for clinical intervention [[11], [12], [13], [14], [15], [16], [17], [18]]. Yet the molecular mechanisms by which anxiety modulates fracture healing remain largely undefined, and no targeted therapeutic strategy is currently available.

【Introduction · p0035】Fracture healing is initiated by a well-orchestrated inflammatory response. Neutrophils, as the first immune cells to arrive at the injury site and launch the repair program, clear necrotic debris and release inflammatory signals, thereby laying the groundwork for subsequent bone regeneration [[19], [20], [21], [22]]. Their functional orientation largely dictates the ultimate course of repair. Within the functionally heterogeneous neutrophil pool, the TGFβ1+CCR5+ double-positive subset has recently been identified as a critical regulator of bone metabolism. This subset is the primary source of TGFβ1 in the mouse bone marrow and is aberrantly expanded in age-related bone loss, directly driving reductions in bone mass. Targeted ablation of this population effectively reverses bone loss, underscoring its centrality as a pathological hub in skeletal homeostasis [23]. However, whether anxiety—a highly prevalent negative emotional state in clinical practice—delays fracture healing through aberrant expansion of this bone-specific pathogenic neutrophil subset remains entirely unknown.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Aptamer-functionalized EGCG nanocarrier for neutrophil-targeted AKBA delivery promotes anxiety-related fracture healing》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Material synthesis · p0230】First, 0.51 mg of AKBA powder was dissolved in methanol to prepare an AKBA/methanol solution at a final concentration of 1 mmol/L. The solution (100 μL) was then slowly added dropwise to 900 μL of water under vigorous stirring at 1000 rpm at room temperature using a centrifuge (Eppendorf, 5424R, Hamburg, Germany). The mixture was subjected to ultrasonication (500 W, 40 kHz) for 20 min, and the methanol was removed under a nitrogen stream. The solution was centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 10 min (Eppendorf), and the precipitate was discarded to obtain the AKBA nanoparticle solution. EGCG was purchased from Aladdin Reagent Co., Ltd. (Beijing, China). NIMP-R14-Apt was obtained from Sangon Biotech Co., Ltd. (Shanghai, China). EGCG solutions of varying concentrations (20%, 15%, 10%, and 5%) were prepared in water and added to the 10 μM AKBA nanoparticle solution. The mixture was stirred at 1000 rpm for 10 min to generate EGCG-coated AKBA nanoparticles (AKBA@E). Subsequently, 10 μL of NIMP-R14-Apt (10 mmol/L) was added dropwise to 990 μL of the AKBA@E solution, and the mixture was stirred at 500 rpm overnight to obtain AKBA@E-N.

【Material synthesis · p0235】AKBA@E-N was characterized in this study by TEM morphology, DLS particle size and Zeta potential, XPS/Raman/FTIR spectroscopy, drug loading, encapsulation efficiency, and pH-dependent release. The following parameters were not evaluated experimentally: aptamer surface density, EGCG coating thickness, serum stability, long-term storage stability, and formal lot-to-lot reproducibility. The NIMP-R14 aptamer was linked by physical adsorption, and its presence was qualitatively confirmed by spectroscopic characterization; aptamer density was not quantified. All formulations were prepared fresh prior to each experiment, and no storage stability claims were made.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Aptamer-functionalized EGCG nanocarrier for neutrophil-targeted AKBA delivery promotes anxiety-related fracture healing》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Conclusion · p0485】This study is the first to show that anxiety delays fracture healing by expanding the TGFβ1+CCR5+ pathogenic neutrophil subset and reveals that AKBA depletes this subset by targeting the YAP1–USP31–NF-κB–CCR5 axis. Based on this mechanistic framework, we developed an NIMP-R14-modified EGCG nanocarrier system that actively enriches neutrophils and releases AKBA in response to the fracture microenvironment, thereby significantly accelerating bone healing in anxious mice. By combining mechanical dissection with targeted intervention, this strategy offers new therapeutic avenues for psychological stress-related bone repair disorders.

【CRS impairs fracture healing and expands TGFβ1+CCR5+ neutrophils in mice · p0350】To investigate the effects of anxiety on fracture healing and neutrophil function, we exposed mice to 14 days of chronic restraint stress (CRS) to establish an anxiety model (Fig. S1A–B) [[40], [41], [42]]. CRS-exposed mice spent significantly less time in the open arms of the elevated plus maze and exhibited reduced central zone exploration with a peripheral preference in the open field test, confirming successful induction of anxiety-like behaviours (Fig. S1C and D). During the fracture healing period, mice were not subjected to further restraint to avoid any mechanical interference from immobilization that could confound bone repair assessment [43,44]. Nevertheless, dynamic behavioral monitoring demonstrated that anxiety-like behaviours persisted for at least 21 days after cessation of restraint (Fig. S1K and L). During 14 days of restraint stress, the plasma levels of corticosterone and norepinephrine in mice increased significantly and could continue to be maintained for a long time (Fig. S1E and F). The weight changes of mice during 14 days were also consistent with changes in anxiety stress (Fig. S1G). In addition, during the entire 21-day experiment, there were no significant differences in FST/TST immobility time and sugar water preference between CRS and control mice. This indicates that the mice did not exhibit despair behavior or pleasure deprivation throughout the experimental period, thus largely ruling out the existence of a depressive-like state and confirming the specificity of the anxiety model (Fig. S1H–J) [45,46].

sections.title: 图表阅读
sections.text:
《Aptamer-functionalized EGCG nanocarrier for neutrophil-targeted AKBA delivery promotes anxiety-related fracture healing》：图表的原始标题与说明。

【Scheme 1 · sc1】Scheme 1 Mechanism and therapy of anxiety-related delayed fracture healing. In a mouse model of anxiety combined with fracture, CRS activates the YAP1–USP31–NF-κB–CCR5 signaling axis in neutrophils, leading to abnormal accumulation of TGFβ1+CCR5+ double-positive neutrophils and excessive TGFβ1 secretion. TGFβ1 suppresses TRAF3 expression and activates the NF-κB–CCL5 pathway in BMSCs, forming a positive feedback loop that disturbs bone homeostasis and delays fracture healing. The AKBA@E-N delivery system constructed in this study uses EGCG as the carrier, loads AKBA, and modifies it with the NIMP-R14 aptamer, which can be released in the acidic microenvironment of the fracture site to achieve local retention and enhance neutrophil uptake. By inhibiting the above-mentioned signaling axis, AKBA can reverse healing impairment and promote bone repair.

【Fig. 1 · fig1】Fig. 1 CRS delays fracture healing and increases the proportion of TGFβ1+CCR5+ double-positive neutrophils in mice. (A) X-ray imaging of the control and CRS groups on days 0, 7, 14, and 21 after fracture. n = 6. (B) Micro-CT three-dimensional reconstruction images of fracture ends and quantitative analysis of BV/TV and BMD in mice. n = 6. (C) mRNA levels of Col1a1, Bglap, and Runx2. n = 3. (D) Protein expression levels of CCR5, TGFβ1, and osteogenic markers (COL1A1, OCN, RUNX2). n = 3. (E) Schematic diagram of the isolation and extraction workflow for mouse primary neutrophils. (F) Phenotypic identification and purity verification of primary neutrophils by flow cytometry. (G) Morphological observation of primary neutrophils via immunofluorescence staining under laser confocal microscopy. Scale bar: 5 μm. (H) Morphology and subcellular localization of TGFβ1+CCR5+ double-positive neutrophils detected by immunofluorescence taining under laser confocal microscopy. Scale bar: 5 μm. (I) Representative images of immunofluorescence staining of TGFβ1+CCR5+ double-positive cells, scale bar: 25 μm. n = 3. (J) Flow cytometry shows the proportion of double-positive cells. n = 3. (K) Immunofluorescence images showing TGFβ1+CCR5+ double-positive cells at the site of bone callus in the control and anxiety-induced fracture groups. Scale bars: 200 μm, 40 μm.

【Fig. 2 · fig2】Fig. 2 TGFβ1+CCR5+ neutrophils inhibit osteogenic differentiation of BMSCs in co-culture. (A) Schematic diagram of MACS for TGFβ1+CCR5+ double-positive neutrophils. (B) Immunofluorescence staining of TGFβ1 and CCR5 expression in sorted neutrophils. Scale bar: 5 μm. (C) The proportion of sorted double-positive cells was determined by flow cytometry. (D) Schematic representation of the Transwell co-culture system consisting of TGFβ1+CCR5+ neutrophils and BMSCs. (E) ALP staining and quantitative analysis of positive areas in BMSCs after 7 days of osteogenic induction in co-culture. n = 3. (F) Alizarin red staining and quantitative analysis of positive areas in BMSCs after 14 days of osteogenic induction in co-culture. n = 3. (G) mRNA levels of Col1a1, Bglap, Runx2 in BMSCs following co-culture. n = 3. (H) Protein levels of COL1A1, OCN, and RUNX2 in BMSCs following co-culture. n = 3.
